name: Construction Contract and Practices
description: Bidding process, Introduction to e-procurement, Cost estimation, Rate analysis and specifications, Contract document, Different types of contract, Important contract clauses, Introduction and role of construction equipment and construction technologies, Construction practices related to Reinforcement cutting, bending and tying technologies, Concrete production and placement Technologies, Formwork technologies for Foundations, walls, columns, slab and beams, Formwork Design Concepts, Flying Formwork such as Table form, tunnel form, Slipform, temporary structures, Bridge construction including segmental construction, incremental construction and push launching techniques, Top down construction technology for high rise and underground construction and Prefab construction, Introduction to basic types of construction robots, UAVs and sensors, Additive manufacturing/3-D printing, automated building construction system, BIM and digital twins-Case studies of automated and digital construction applications
